topic: Upskilling Chemical Engineers in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
title: Upskilling Chemical Engineers in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
session_title: Upskilling Your Career with Emerging Technologies
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) are no longer “just hype” but foundational technologies that are woven into most of our modern-day processes. Steeped in over 40 years of rich history within the field of chemical engineering, AI/ML techniques will need to be deeply understood at all levels spanning from the lab intern to the executive leading a global fleet of industrial plants. This session presents a framework for reviewing foundational skills rooted in first principles, pathways to engagement, and use cases for a broad range of roles. Let’s build a long-term AI/ML skill map tailored for all chemical engineers.

topic: Upskilling in Process Safety and Cybersecurity, Sustainability
title: Upskilling in Process Safety and Cybersecurity, Sustainability
session_title: Upskilling Your Career with Emerging Technologies
abstract: Process Safety and CyberSecurity A fundamental understanding of Process Safety and CyberSecurity is critical to ensure operations and data systems are kept safe. Whether you are in Operations, Engineering, or in Management, having knowledge and experience in these areas provides a foundation for ensuring a business maintains the right to operate and personnel are kept safe. Sustainability Sustainability and the circular economy is not just the latest buzz word... it can make good business sense to invest in this area. Sustainable programs such as reducing waste, reworking by products, and minimizing the impact of your process can reduce costs and increase margins.

title: Continuous Learning
session_title: Upskilling Your Career with Emerging Technologies
abstract: Upskilling Your Career via Continuous Learning Continuous learning is essential for chemical engineers to keep up with the fast-paced technology transformation while developing competitive and innovation skills in the workplace. Many emerging concepts, such as machine learning and sustainability, have rapidly become vital or even required skills for the chemical industry. In this session, we discuss the continuous learning sources which can facilitate timely and systematic learning of new knowledge. We will review the eLearning courses offered by AIChE and other academic universities. We will also discuss how to leverage the opportunities offered by many industrial companies for career development advising and employee development plans.

authors: Yuhe Tian | West Virginia University, Morgantown, WV

title: Networking & Practical Experience
session_title: Upskilling Your Career with Emerging Technologies
abstract: Emerging technology develops quickly, and it is vital for chemical engineers to stay abreast of tools, applications, insights and risks. Networking and practical experience are key aspects of getting and staying on the leading edge. This session will share ways to develop your network to help gain insight, see emerging applications, frame dilemmas and seek additional expertise for surmounting challenges. We will also show how to keep focus on what needs to get done for you and your teams to get higher impact.
presenting_author: Gayle Gibson | Mission Possible Partnership, Newark, DE
authors: Gayle Gibson | Mission Possible Partnership, Newark, DE

title: Enlisting a Mentor
session_title: Upskilling Your Career with Emerging Technologies
abstract: Engineers and scientists benefit greatly from the expertise and experience of other individuals (mentors) who can guide and support them throughout their career. Approaches to identifying and engaging effective mentors will be discussed.
